subject: Civic Hall evidence for the January 2016 New York City Council constituent-services hackathon
finding: No dedicated Civic Hall calendar listing or event-detail page was recovered for the January 2016 New York City Council constituent-services hackathon.
limitations: Failure to recover a page does not prove that no page ever existed.
The archived Civic Hall page preserves social posts through an embedded feed; it is not itself the event listing.
No full agenda, breakout roster, registration-form contents, or dedicated event page was recovered.
publicSummary: A broad Wayback/CDX search did not recover a dedicated Civic Hall event page.
